Reference image 2 is ONLY the polished clean cartoon linework/shading style reference, DO NOT copy its fire temple or monster. prompts.boss: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent PNG game sprite for MapleStory boss WILL in giant SPIDER form. Reference 1 is the exact spider design identity. Reference 2 is ONLY linework/shading polish style; do not copy its content. Redraw the giant arachnid cleanly, full body centered, three-quarter slightly left-facing side-view like reference 1: massive near-black broad segmented oval abdomen, black armored thorax, small sharply pointed head with narrow glowing white-red crescent eyes; EIGHT long angular jointed black blade-like legs arranged four per side, long pointed crimson glowing tips and thin red cracks. Keep the whole creature very dark, no brown, no hairy realistic tarantula, no humanoid face or humanoid limbs, no clothes, no book. A few tiny red sparks, but NO big flame cloud covering anatomy. Eight complete legs all fit inside canvas with generous margins and clearly join thorax. Strong clean readable silhouette. Polished hand-drawn 2D cartoon boss art with controlled cel shading, matching game's clean MapleStory style. No scene or floor, no shadow baked outside sprite, no UI or lettering, no sigil, genuinely transparent background. Wide landscape composition, giant abdomen slightly behind head as in reference; NOT a front-view cute spider.
prompts.atlas: Use case: precise-object-edit. Turn the attached spider boss illustration into an animation-ready DISASSEMBLED sprite sheet on true transparent background. Preserve exact near-black segmented shell, pointed head with white-red eyes, crimson cracks and red glowing tips, clean 2D style. Square 2048x2048 atlas with an invisible strict 3 columns x 3 rows grid, NINE separate objects, each wholly inside one cell with clear transparent padding, no labels or grid lines. TOP LEFT cell: the COMPLETE abdomen+thorax+head connected together, with ALL EIGHT LEGS REMOVED cleanly, reconstructing hidden body so there are no holes or leg stumps projecting. Keep original three-quarter left-facing body perspective. Remaining EIGHT cells: one whole complete articulated leg per cell, shoulder/upper segment to knee then long pointed lower blade with red tip, matching the attached spider's eight leg perspectives. Top middle and top right: rear far-side legs. Middle row: two middle far-side legs then front near-side leg. Bottom row: remaining three near-side legs. Each leg is an independent cutout with round shoulder attachment at its upper-inner end and its natural bend, no detached tips, no torso fragment attached. Keep each full leg easy to rotate about its shoulder; legs do NOT touch each other or cross cell bounds. Do NOT draw an assembled spider anywhere. No background, no floor, no shadow, no symbols or text. Use all cell area efficiently with at least 35px transparent margins around every piece. Do not add extra body/leg fragments.
